context.transcript:
Welcome, new editors, to this training session.
At Paper Lantern Books, we use very specific editorial standards for our publications.
This session has been designed to familiarize you with them.
First, we'll go ove this handbook of our company's style and rules.
It has all the information you need for your daily work, plus examples for us to discuss as a group.
Then, I'll talk about how to work with our authors.
Remember, our job is about bringing the authors' ideas to the page.
We have a lot to cover, and the management team has this room at one o'clock.
context.transcript_translation:
欢迎新编辑们参加本次培训课程。
在 Paper Lantern Books，我们为出版物使用非常具体的编辑标准。
本次课程旨在让您熟悉这些标准。
首先，我们将回顾公司风格和规则手册。
它包含了您日常工作所需的所有信息，以及供我们小组讨论的示例。
然后，我将谈论如何与我们的作者合作。
请记住，我们的工作是把作者的想法呈现在纸上。
我们有很多内容要涵盖，管理团队已经预定了一点的这个房间。
